Hi Diego / Marissa / Neha,

Attached is Taylor Brooks' resume and a short availability matrix. They can do a two half-day virtual loop (AM session + PM session) instead of one long day. We propose a "hopscotch" sequencing to reduce cognitive load: interviewers rotate between shorter focused panels rather than one contiguous block. Proposed plan (Pacific times):

Day 1 (Thu Jul 1) — AM (9:00–12:00)
- 9:00–9:35: Screen + system design (Diego)
- 9:45–10:20: API & infra (Marissa)
- 10:30–11:05: Data models/DB (external hiring mgr)
- 11:15–11:45: Buffer / follow-ups

Day 2 (Fri Jul 2) — PM (13:00–16:00)
- 13:00–13:35: Deep dive code pairing (Marissa)
- 13:45–14:20: Performance & scaling (Diego)
- 14:30–15:05: Behavioral / culture (Neha)
- 15:15–15:45: Debrief (internal panel)

We recommend:
- 20–25 minute interviews + 10 minute assessor notes to keep cadence tight;
- Clear debrief owner per track (Diego: systems; Marissa: code; Neha: behavioral)
- Shared eval rubric attached.

Please confirm whether the sequencing works and who will own the debrief on Day 2 (we flagged 15:15–15:45 as the collective debrief). Taylor prefers Zoom links in calendar invites and a quick prep note.

Thanks —
Kara
